text: Why did the math book look sad? It had too many problems.
What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
Why couldn't the bicycle stand up by itself? It was two-tired.
What do you call a fish wearing a bowtie? Sofishticated.
Why did the coffee file a police report? It got mugged.
What do you call a factory that makes okay products? A satisfactory.
Why did the golfer bring two pairs of pants? In case he got a hole in one.
What do you call a bear with no teeth? A gummy bear.
Why can't you hear a pterodactyl using the bathroom? Because the P is silent.
What do you call an alligator in a vest? An investigator.
Why did the tomato blush? It saw the salad dressing.
What do you call a sleeping bull? A bulldozer.
Why did the computer go to the doctor? It had a virus.
What do you call a belt made of watches? A waist of time.
Why did the cookie go to the hospital? It felt crummy.
What do you call a pile of cats? A meowtain.
Why did the banana go to the doctor? It wasn't peeling well.
What do you call a cow with no legs? Ground beef.
What do you call a cow with two legs? Lean beef.
Why do bees have sticky hair? Because they use honeycombs.
What do you call a boomerang that won't come back? A stick.
Why did the stadium get hot after the game? All the fans left.
What do you call a dinosaur with an extensive vocabulary? A thesaurus.
Why did the broom get promoted? It swept the competition.
What do you call a snowman with a six-pack? An abdominal snowman.
Why did the picture go to jail? It was framed.
What did one wall say to the other wall? I'll meet you at the corner.
Why don't eggs tell jokes? They'd crack each other up.
What do you call a can opener that doesn't work? A can't opener.
Why did the orange stop halfway up the hill? It ran out of juice.
What do you call a magician's dog? A Labracadabrador.
Why was six afraid of seven? Because seven eight nine.
What did the ocean say to the beach? Nothing. It just waved.
Why did the melon jump into the lake? It wanted to be a watermelon.
What do you call a duck that gets straight A's? A wise quacker.
Why did the music teacher need a ladder? To reach the high notes.
What do you call a fish with no eyes? Fsh.
Why did the barber win the race? He knew a shortcut.
What do you call a nervous javelin thrower? Shakespeare.
Why did the chicken join a band? Because it had the drumsticks.
What do you call a dog that can do magic? A labracadabrador.
Why don't oysters donate to charity? Because they're shellfish.
What do you call a cow during an earthquake? A milkshake.
Why did the mushroom get invited to every party? Because he was a fungi.
What do you call a fly without wings? A walk.
Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
What did the janitor say when he jumped out of the closet? Supplies!
Why did the calendar get nervous? Its days were numbered.
What do you call a lazy kangaroo? A pouch potato.
Why did the man fall into the well? Because he couldn't see that well.
What do you call a group of musical whales? An orca-stra.
Why did the invisible man turn down the job offer? He couldn't see himself doing it.
What do you call a bee that can't make up its mind? A maybe.
Why did the belt get arrested? It held up a pair of pants.
What do you call a cold dog? A chili dog.
Why did the clock get sent to the principal's office? It kept tocking back.
What do you call a rabbit with fleas? Bugs Bunny.
Why did the grape stop in the middle of the road? It ran out of juice.
What do you call a line of rabbits hopping backward? A receding hareline.
Why did the baker stop making donuts? He got tired of the hole business.
What do you call a pig that knows karate? A pork chop.
Why did the lamp fail school? It wasn't very bright.
What do you call a deer with no eyes? No-eye deer.
Why was the computer cold? It left its Windows open.
What did one plate say to the other plate? Dinner's on me.
Why did the pencil get an award? It was outstanding in its field of writing.
What do you call a sheep with no legs? A cloud.
Why did the teddy bear skip dessert? It was stuffed.
What do you call an elephant that doesn't matter? An irrelephant.
Why did the skeleton go to the barbecue? To get another rib.
What do you call a sleeping pizza? A piZZZZa.
Why was the math lecture so long? The professor kept going off on a tangent.
What do you call a cow that plays an instrument? A moosician.
Why did the banker switch careers? He lost interest.
What do you call a train carrying bubble gum? A chew-chew train.
Why did the grape complain? It was tired of being pressed.
What do you call a cat that loves bowling? An alley cat.
Why did the football coach go to the bank? To get his quarterback.
What do you call a bear caught in the rain? A drizzly bear.
Why did the cookie cry? Its mother was a wafer so long.
What do you call a potato wearing glasses? A spec-tater.
Why was the broom late? It overswept.
What do you call a broken pumpkin? Squash.
Why did the astronaut break up with the moon? He needed space.
What do you call a crocodile detective? An investi-gator.
Why did the frog take the bus to work? His car got toad.
What do you call a cow that just gave birth? Decalfinated.
Why did the scarecrow become a motivational speaker? He was outstanding in his field and knew how to raise crops.
What do you call a snail on a ship? A snailor.
Why did the computer take a nap? It needed to reboot.
What do you call a penguin in the desert? Lost.
Why did the sandwich go to the gym? It wanted better buns.
What do you call a musician with problems? A trebled person.
Why did the pirate buy an eye patch? He couldn't sea very well.
What do you call a sheep covered in chocolate? A candy baa.
Why did the gardener plant a light bulb? He wanted to grow a power plant.
What do you call a very small valentine? A valen-tiny.
Why did the phone wear glasses? It lost its contacts.
What do you call a dinosaur that crashes his car? Tyrannosaurus wrecks.
Why did the dad bring a ladder to the bar? He heard the drinks were on the house.
